description: One ticker's state: latest snapshot, one date, a start/end series, or band events (field, optional band: when it was entered, what it left, how long it lasted; stats=true for counts). fields trims to sections or paths, e.g. trend, momentum.rsi_zone, fundamentals.pe_ratio. Market regimes are in get_market.

append.description: Add rows to an existing store_as table instead of replacing it.

band.description: Events for this band value only.

context_ticker.description: Second ticker to condition events on.

field.description: Band field for events, e.g. momentum_rsi_zone.

store_as.description: Table name: store rows in SQLite, return only a summary. Read with query_data.

timeframe.description: Default: daily (every plan reads daily and weekly).

name: get_summary
